Repair instead of buying new

A pair of well-made shoes can last for decades with the right care. Resoling or new heels cost a fraction of a new pair – better for your wallet and for the planet. We only use high-quality materials and work carefully at every step.

Specialists in welted shoes and riding boots

Goodyear-welted shoes can be resoled again and again – if the job is done right. It is a craft we have practised for more than 30 years. We also re-bottom riding boots, a job that requires experience and the right tools.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need an appointment for shoe repair?

No. Bring your shoes to our shop at Nygatan 22 and we will look at them right away and tell you what is needed.

How much does resoling or a new heel cost?

It depends on the shoes and the material needed. You always get a price from us before we start.

How long does a shoe repair take?

It depends on the job. When you drop off your shoes we tell you when they will be ready.

Do you repair riding boots?

Yes, we specialise in re-bottoming and repairing riding boots.
